results.title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory 55th Anniversary Celebration
description: The Library of Congress presents a celebration of the 55th anniversary of “Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory,” which is featured on the National Film Registry. This special event includes a panel discussion and Q&A with original cast members, a performance of excerpts from composer and lyricist Leslie Bricusse’s score, and a display of original materials from the creation of the film.

results.title: Gutenberg Bible

results.title: Here to Stay: The Legacy of George and Ira Gershwin
